storage.bytes_fsynced is a proxy: the WAL on-disk byte count (every committed WAL byte is fsynced before commit acknowledgement), not a directly-observed fsync counter.

storage.* is the REAL on-disk footprint of the 'recodb' database after the ladder: a 6635520 B store image plus a 46388662 B WAL DIRECTORY of segment files (walked by PATH). The amplification ratios are those durable bytes over the generator's 2433133 B logical CSV.
